mapper.select: SELECT f.form_field_id::TEXT AS row_id, f.form_id::TEXT AS form_id, f.label, f.field_cd, fc.name AS field_name, f.options, f.placeholder, f.required_yn, f.privacy_yn, f.sort_no FROM form_field f LEFT JOIN code fc ON fc.code_id = f.field_cd AND fc.p_code_id = 'FIELD00' WHERE f.form_id = #{formId}::integer AND f.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY f.sort_no, f.form_field_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO form_field (form_id, label, field_cd, options, placeholder, required_yn, privacy_yn, sort_no, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{formId}::integer, #{label}, #{fieldCd}, #{options}, #{placeholder}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{requiredYn}, ''), 'N'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{privacyYn}, ''), 'N'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortNo}, '')::integer, 0), 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE form_field SET label = #{label}, field_cd = #{fieldCd}, options = #{options}, placeholder = #{placeholder}, required_yn = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{requiredYn}, ''), 'N'), privacy_yn = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{privacyYn}, ''), 'N'), sort_no = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sortNo}, '')::integer, 0), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE form_field_id = #{rowId}::integer

UPDATE form_field SET use_yn = 'N', upd_dt = NOW() WHERE form_id = #{formId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
AND form_field_id NOT IN #{id}::integer
